Description: Hardcoded absolute path to local git workspace in config/code/scripts
Author: Cason Konzer
Message:
fix(dnsmasq): use bind-dynamic and add OnFailure email notifier

bind-interfaces conflicts with bind-dynamic when both short-circuit
and pit-box dnsmasq configs are installed together. Switching to
bind-dynamic is the correct setting for a WireGuard interface that
comes up after dnsmasq starts.

Adds dnsmasq --test validation after writing the DNS config so
conflicts are caught at install time rather than silently at next boot.

Adds scripts/install_failure_notifier.sh which installs:
- /usr/local/bin/service-failure-notify (shock-relay email notifier)
- /etc/systemd/system/service-failure-notify@.service (template unit)
- /etc/systemd/system/dnsmasq.service.d/on-failure-notify.conf

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
